topSignals.title: Elcogen crosses six weeks quiet (41 days) and Topsoe passes nine and a half weeks (66 days) — a full sweep across all three competitor tiers, the AI-datacenter deployment pipeline, regulation, competing on-site power, market/financials, research/IP, and the benchmark register again found nothing genuinely new.
topSignals.text: Direct English- and German-language searches for both priority stacks returned only historical background (factory openings, funding rounds, the Aug 27 financial-outlook item already logged). An apparently fresh-looking news trail — "Nebius Vineland Phase 2 approval," a "second stop-construction order" on Bloom Energy fuel cells, and a DA Davidson price-target cut — was run down and confirmed to be recycled August 2026 reporting (stop-work orders Aug 6/10, price-target cut Aug 11, a $1.07M air-permit fine Sept 22) that predates and is superseded by the already-logged Oct 22 "first power block ready" milestone, not a new development. Elcogen News | Topsoe press releases

items.text: Elcogen (priority): No new news-archive item since Sept 21 (Metrosert cooperation), confirmed via English- and German-language searches today — 41 days quiet. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (75% FC electrical efficiency / 90% with heat recovery, 33 kWh/kg H2 SOEC — vendor claims) in volume production at the 360 MW/yr ELCO I Tallinn factory.

Topsoe (priority): No new solid-oxide-specific release since the Aug 27 H1 2026 results/SOEC pathway reset, confirmed via English- and German-language searches today — 66 days quiet; topsoe.com/press-releases remains dominated by SAF/ammonia/e-methanol/blue-hydrogen news, out of SOFC/SOEC scope.

Today's Tier 2 dedicated rotation — round 3 (Kyocera, Aisin): no new stack/cell-technology items for either; results were SEO-aggregator recaps of standing 2025-vintage SOFC-cogeneration background and routine autoparts-earnings coverage, no 2026 primary SOFC disclosure.
Tier 2 sweep — "Bloom Energy OR FuelCell Energy OR Ceres Power OR Sunfire OR SolydEra": no new item; results recycled standing earnings/data-center-deal background already in the archive.

Today's Tier 3 dedicated rotation — new cycle 6, round 1 (Reverion, Convion, Hexis, Doosan Fuel Cell, SK ecoplant, Weichai), 7-day lookback: no new items for any of the six; results repeated the standing Sept 29 Reverion $175M Series B, the Sept 18 Doosan-Reverion $78M stack order, Convion's 2024 HD Hyundai acquisition history, Hexis's long-dormant ownership-history background, SK ecoplant's 2023-vintage GDS Singapore story, and Weichai's standing SOFC-backup-generator positioning. One adjacent item checked and ruled out: SK ecoplant affiliate SK Eternix's separate Chungju Eco Park plant (40 MW SOFC, South Korea) is a December 2025-vintage commercial-operation story, not new, and is a distinct site from the already-logged SK Eternix Icheon/Paju 28 MW plant.

Tier 3 sweeps — "Watt Fuel Cell OR OxEon Energy OR Nexceris OR Kawasaki Heavy Industries OR Miura", "Fraunhofer IKTS OR Plansee OR Huatsing Power OR Ningbo SOFCMAN OR Chaozhou Three-Circle", and "Delta Electronics OR Shell OR Denso OR Thermax": no new item across any of these; results repeated standing background (Miura/Ceres 4.2kW Japan launch, Nexceris LEVER/SOEC scale-up deal, Fraunhofer IKTS interconnect research, Ceres-Delta/Shell/Denso/Thermax licensing). Chaozhou Three-Circle (CCTC) again returned no company-specific SOFC/SOEC news — continuing open data gap.
Competitor roster: SOFC systems for data centers

Bloom Energy: Deployed/signed at multiple named sites — Oracle/Project Jupiter (NM, installation underway, hearing Dec 7), AEP (1 GW), Brookfield EaaS, Nebius (328 MW/$2.6B, Vineland NJ — first power block reported ready Oct 22; block capacity undisclosed; site not yet operational), Equinix (>100 MW/19 sites), Aligned "Project Phoenix" (2 GW, PA), Hitachi (Japan), SK Eternix (Icheon/Paju, Korea, 28 MW, operational).

FuelCell Energy (incl. HyAxiom-branded products): Signed orders/PPAs — Fit Energy (up to 380 MW), Inuverse Korea (up to 100 MW), 75 MW Texas Capacity Reservation Agreement, SDCL (up to 450 MW). No named deployment live yet.

Doosan Fuel Cell/HyAxiom: Signed order — US AI data center supply contract (KRW 823.6B cumulative, mixed SOFC/PAFC); separately supplies SOFC stacks to Reverion. No named data-center site of its own yet.
Convion: Pipeline-only/pre-commercial under HD Hyundai ownership; no named data-center customer.
SK ecoplant: Pipeline-only (2023-vintage GDS Singapore SOFC deal); no new named data-center deployment.
Ceres Power's SOFC licensees (Doosan, Delta Electronics, Weichai): Licensing/pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment via Ceres licensing directly.
Reverion: Pipeline-only — Doosan-supplied SOFC stacks for rSOC power plants (Germany); no named data-center customer yet.
Petra Power: Pre-commercial, no named customer; first infrastructure deployment targeted 2028.
